documentation_summary: OpenSSH documents only literal-percent and remote-hostname tokens for Hostname. No broader token expansion is proposed.
algorithm: After selecting first applicable HostName and setdefault(hostname, host), use a single re.sub(r"%[%h]", lambda match: "%" if match.group(0)=="%%" else host, selected["hostname"]). The scanner consumes original template pairs once; escaped percent output and substituted host are never scanned again. No chained replacements.
scope: Only existing _ssh_lookup body plus focused native regression; retain other fields/first-value/Include scope/Match nonexecution and malformed/unsupported token behavior. No new helper, caption, signature or API prose.
